A Quiet Morning

CHAPTER I. The garden

The garden was quiet in the morning. A young reader opened a book beside the window. She was curious about the world beyond the hills, and every page offered a different journey.

Reading a little every day made the unfamiliar words feel more familiar. She kept a small notebook for the words she wanted to remember.

CHAPTER II. A new story

After breakfast, she walked down the road to the library. The librarian smiled and placed another book on the table. It was the beginning of a wonderful adventure.
